article.summary_es: Reach Out and Touch Food Pantry es una despensa de alimentos en Staten Island, en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
article.summary_en: Reach Out and Touch Food Pantry is a food pantry in Staten Island, listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos según el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está ubicada en 51 Cottage Pl, Staten Island, NY, 10302.
Abre los sábados; la despensa funciona el 3er sábado de 11:00AM a 1:00PM.
Puede llamar al (718) 442-5007 para preguntar antes de ir.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 51 Cottage Pl, Staten Island, NY, 10302.
It is open on Saturdays; the pantry runs the 3rd Saturday from 11:00AM to 1:00PM.
You can call (718) 442-5007 to ask before you go.
visit_tips_es: El horario indicado es: Sat 12pm-1pm (despensa: 3er sábado 11:00AM - 1:00PM).
No se indica qué alimentos entrega ni si hay requisitos; pregunte por teléfono.
Verifique el horario antes de ir, ya que puede cambiar.
visit_tips_en: The listed hours are: Sat 12pm-1pm (pantry: 3rd Saturday 11:00AM - 1:00PM).
What food is given and any requirements are not listed; ask by phone.
Check the hours before going, as they may change.
